name: ordelo-agent
description: An AI-powered on-demand food delivery orchestration system that manages the full delivery lifecycle (order placement, restaurant confirmation, rider dispatch, live tracking, and completion) via the WhatsApp Business API, using FastAPI, LangGraph stateful agents, and PostgreSQL/Supabase for persistence. Note: this project has over 100 source files; consider scoping analysis to a subdirectory for faster results.
